title: State engine — completion to 1.0
description:
Single home for the state-engine proof/evidence campaign, flattened from the v2 milestone/phase/step tree (elspeth-4b3d734e3a, now cancelled as superseded).

Absorbs the 4 proof-cohort steps, the final assessment step, all 13 open '[state engine]' tasks and bugs (11 P2, 2 P3), and the disputed Task 9 closure. Membership manifest is in the first comment.

STRUCTURAL FACT (assessment 2026-08-15-0537; freeze F=2b4b04a8a, published 1c0d93b67, merged to release/0.7.2 at 4d78035): 73/73 legs are 'unknown', ZERO confirmed. 489/7010 cells promoted (417 pass, 72 partial). 6,521 residual = 1,780 live-lane + 4,741 local. HG-09 open; verdict not_complete.

The verdict is SINGLE-GATED ON AWS. completeness-criteria.md makes postgresql-16-aws-single-leader-landscape a required profile for every mandatory cell and states an assessor cannot mark a dimension N/A merely because it is inconvenient to execute. AWS was torn down 2026-08-10. Only RC-05 and PB-08 have zero live cells and they sit in different cohorts, so no amount of local work closes a cohort step. Plan: docs/plans/2026-08-15-state-engine-six-issue-disposition.md
